title: Words from Eathon/Quotes
summary:
"Nostradamus believed that if his true resting place were discovered, it would be looted by grave robbers." (Sophie Casterwill)

"We actually prefer the title 'ancient artifact enthusiasts'." (Dante Vale)

"The age of the Titans draws to an end. Now, the Nullifiers will reign!"
- Rassimov to the Blooded Circle

"That's a first. I don't think we've ever been ambushed before we could get off the plane."
- Sophie Casterwill to the team.

"You're too late. The Spiral is revealed!"
- Marduk to Lok Lambert

"It's the moment of truth. This is it."
- Sophie Casterwill to Dante Vale before being teleported to the Spiral Mark

"Seekers, we have a world to save."
- Dante Vale to the team
